messages:
Sabrina Morales: Quick sync — Kestrel Health cohort (alpha) workshop next week. Need to lock instructor slots + agenda. Their top asks: model-drift detection walkthrough and cost-control practices. I have two candidate times: Tue 10:00am PT or Fri 14:00 UTC. Which works and who can teach the hands-on lab?

Ryan Kim: I can own the model-drift demo. Tue 10:00am PT works for me for the live demo + Q&A. Prefer hands-on lab rather than slides.

Maya Li: Fri 14:00 UTC works for me (easier for APAC). I can build the lab (notebook + starter prompts) and a short preread video. Will need list of customer IAM users to pre-provision.

Nick Patel: I’ll grab the IAM list from Kestrel and confirm headcount (expecting 8–12). Also can request GPU quota bump if needed.

Sabrina Morales: Thinking: do both — primary live Tue for NA, repeat Fri for APAC. Keep agendas identical. Any ops blockers?

Jen Ortiz: I’ll handle Zoom setup, recording, and the post-workshop takeaways doc. I can also set calendar reminders at 48h and 2h.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Kestrel Health — Inference Workshop (Tue 10:00am PT)" — https://calendar.example.com/e/abc123 (Creator: Sabrina Morales)

Ryan Kim: Small ask — please add a 10-min "cost runbook" slide: batching/quantization knobs + expected per-token cost. I can draft that.

Maya Li: Noted. Lab plan draft:```
1) 5m intro + goals
2) 35m demo (drift detection + tracing)
3) 40m hands-on lab (notebook + pre-filled prompts)
4) 10m cost runbook + q/a
5) follow-up checklist + next steps
```

Nick Patel: Confirmed with infra — GPU quota bumped to 3 for the workshop region. I’ll DM proof to Maya for env setup.

Jen Ortiz: Calendar updated with both events (Tue 10:00am PT & Fri 14:00 UTC). Agenda attached and reminders set. Recording enabled.

Sabrina Morales: Perfect. Final operational asks: someone please share the preread (15-min vid + config checklist) 48h before each session, and capture a renewal-health note after the workshop (check-in ~2 weeks post). @Nick can you own the renewal follow-up?

Nick Patel: Happy to. I’ll schedule the renewal check-in for 2 weeks post-workshop and include usage/engagement metrics.

Ryan Kim: :thumbsup: I’ll send the cost slide draft by EOD.

Maya Li: Sending lab repo + preread video link tomorrow AM. Need the IAM list by EOD today to finish provisioning.

Sabrina Morales: Thanks team — locking this. If any blocker, ping in this thread.
